questions.chunk_path: PART A 高分子化学与物理 > UNIT 1 What are Polymers?
questions.question: The globules of polyvinyl alcohol first absorb water, swell and get distorted in shape and after a long time go into solution.
questions.answer: 聚乙烯醇颗粒首先吸水溶胀，发生形变，经过很长的时间以后，（聚乙烯醇分子）进入到溶剂中。
questions.ref: UNIT 1 What are Polymers? · Notes 2
questions.evidence: The globules of polyvinyl alcohol first absorb water, swell and get distorted in shape and after a long time go into solution.

questions.chunk_path: PART A 高分子化学与物理 > UNIT 1 What are Polymers?
questions.question: Another peculiarity is that, in water, polyvinyl alcohol never retains its original powdery nature as the excess sodium chloride does in a saturated salt solution.
questions.answer: 另一个特点是，在水中聚乙烯醇不会像过量的氯化钠在饱和盐溶液中那样能保持其初始的粉末状态。
questions.ref: UNIT 1 What are Polymers? · Notes 3
questions.evidence: Another peculiarity is that, in water, polyvinyl alcohol never retains its original powdery nature as the excess sodium chloride does in a saturated salt solution.

questions.chunk_path: PART A 高分子化学与物理 > UNIT 2 Chain Polymerization
questions.question: These are energy-rich compounds which can add suitable unsaturated compounds (monomers) and maintain the activated radical, or ionic, state so that further monomer molecules can be added in the same manner.
questions.answer: 这些（化合物）是高能态化合物，它们可以加成不饱和化合物（单体），并且在完成一步加成以后仍然可以保持自由基活性中心或离子活性中心，致使单体分子可以用同样的方式进一步加成。
questions.ref: UNIT 2 Chain Polymerization · Notes 3
questions.evidence: These are energy-rich compounds which can add suitable unsaturated compounds (monomers) and maintain the activated radical, or ionic, state so that further monomer molecules can be added in the same manner.

questions.chunk_path: PART A 高分子化学与物理 > UNIT 2 Chain Polymerization
questions.question: For the individual steps of the growth reaction one needs only a relatively small activation energy and therefore through a single activation step (the actual initiation reaction) a large number of olefin molecules are converted, as is implied by the term 'chain reaction'.
questions.answer: 对于链增长反应的诸多步骤来说，每一步仅需要相当少的活化能，因此，通过一步简单的活化反应（即引发反应）即可将许多烯类单体分子转化（成聚合物），这正如连锁反应这个术语的内涵那样。
questions.ref: UNIT 2 Chain Polymerization · Notes 4
questions.evidence: For the individual steps of the growth reaction one needs only a relatively small activation energy and therefore through a single activation step (the actual initiation reaction) a large number of olefin molecules are converted, as is implied by the term 'chain reaction'.

questions.evidence: Reaction (3.1) illustrates the former, while (3.2) is of the latter type.

questions.chunk_path: PART A 高分子化学与物理 > UNIT 3 Step Growth Polymerization
questions.question: The esterification reaction occurs anywhere in the monomer matrix where two monomer molecules collide, and once the ester has formed, it, too, can react further by virtue of its still-reactive hydroxyl or carboxyl groups.
questions.answer: 酯化反应出现在单体本体中两个单体分子相碰撞的位置，且酯一旦形成，依靠酯上仍有活性的羟基或羧基还可以进一步进行反应。
questions.ref: UNIT 3 Step Growth Polymerization · Notes 2
questions.evidence: The esterification reaction occurs anywhere in the monomer matrix where two monomer molecules collide, and once the ester has formed, it, too, can react further by virtue of its still-reactive hydroxyl or carboxyl groups.

questions.chunk_path: PART A 高分子化学与物理 > UNIT 3 Step Growth Polymerization
questions.question: The net effect of this is that monomer molecules are consumed rapidly without any large increase in molecular weight.
questions.answer: （单体或聚合物末端活性基团间）酯化的结果是单体分子很快地被消耗掉，而分子量却没有什么增大。
questions.ref: UNIT 3 Step Growth Polymerization · Notes 3
questions.evidence: The net effect of this is that monomer molecules are consumed rapidly without any large increase in molecular weight.

questions.chunk_path: PART A 高分子化学与物理 > UNIT 3 Step Growth Polymerization
questions.question: But each polymer molecule that forms still has reactive end groups; hence the polymerization reaction will continue in a stepwise fashion, with each esterification step being identical in rate and mechanism to the initial esterification of monomers.
questions.answer: 但所形成的每个聚合物分子仍然具有反应性末端基团，因此，聚合反应将以逐步的方式继续进行，其每一步酯化反应的反应速率和反应机理均与初始单体的酯化作用相同。
questions.ref: UNIT 3 Step Growth Polymerization · Notes 4
questions.evidence: But each polymer molecule that forms still has reactive end groups; hence the polymerization reaction will continue in a stepwise fashion, with each esterification step being identical in rate and mechanism to the initial esterification of monomers.

questions.chunk_path: PART A 高分子化学与物理 > UNIT 6 Polymer Solution
questions.question: This may be all that happens if, for example, the polymer-polymer intermolecular forces are high because of crosslinking, crystallinity, or strong hydrogen bonding.
questions.answer: 例如，如果因交联、结晶或很强的氢键而形成很大的分子间力，（聚合物的溶解过程）有可能就只停留在这一阶段。

questions.chunk_path: PART A 高分子化学与物理 > UNIT 6 Polymer Solution
questions.question: As specified in the literature, the arrangements of the polymer chain differing by reason of rotations about single bonds are termed conformations.
questions.answer: 正如文献中所定义的那样，由于围绕单键旋转而导致的聚合物链不同的空间排列叫做构象。

questions.evidence: As specified in the literature, the arrangements of the polymer chain differing by reason of rotations about single bonds are termed conformations.

questions.chunk_path: PART A 高分子化学与物理 > UNIT 6 Polymer Solution
questions.question: The random coil (Fig. 6-1) arises from the relative freedom of rotation associated with the chain bonds of most polymers and the formidably large number of conformations accessible to the molecule.
questions.answer: 无规线团（图 6.1）一方面是由于聚合物链上的键自由旋转而产生的，另一方面是由于（聚合物）分子（链）可达到巨大的构象数目而产生的。

questions.chunk_path: PART A 高分子化学与物理 > UNIT 7 Morphology of Solid Polymers
questions.question: X-ray and electron diffraction patterns often show the sharp features typical of three-dimensionally ordered, crystalline materials as well as the diffuse features characteristic of liquids.
questions.answer: （固体聚合物的）X 射线图和电子衍射图样经常会显示出三维有序晶体材料的图样所具有的边缘清晰的特性，也会显示出液体的图样所具有的边缘模糊的特征。
questions.ref: UNIT 7 Morphology of Solid Polymers · Notes 1
questions.evidence: X-ray and electron diffraction patterns often show the sharp features typical of three-dimensionally ordered, crystalline materials as well as the diffuse features characteristic of liquids.

questions.chunk_path: PART A 高分子化学与物理 > UNIT 7 Morphology of Solid Polymers
questions.question: Polymer molecules are considered to pass through several different crystalline regions with crystallites being formed when segments from different polymer chains are precisely aligned together and undergo crystallization.
questions.answer: 当来自不同聚合物分子的链段精确地排列在一起并结晶时，聚合物分子会穿过几个不同的晶区。
questions.ref: UNIT 7 Morphology of Solid Polymers · Notes 2
questions.evidence: Polymer molecules are considered to pass through several different crystalline regions with crystallites being formed when segments from different polymer chains are precisely aligned together and undergo crystallization.

questions.chunk_path: PART A 高分子化学与物理 > UNIT 7 Morphology of Solid Polymers
questions.question: Semi crystalline polymers are considered by advocates of the folded chain theory to be chain-folded crystals with varying amounts of defects.
questions.answer: 折叠链理论的倡导者们认为半结晶聚合物是具有不同数量缺陷的折叠链晶体。
questions.ref: UNIT 7 Morphology of Solid Polymers · Notes 3
questions.evidence: Semi crystalline polymers are considered by advocates of the folded chain theory to be chain-folded crystals with varying amounts of defects.

questions.chunk_path: PART A 高分子化学与物理 > UNIT 7 Morphology of Solid Polymers
questions.question: Polymers with medium to low crystallinity can often be advantageously treated by the fringed micelle concept as two-phase systems composed of crystallites imbedded in uncrystallized, amorphous polymer.
questions.answer: 具有从中等到较低结晶度的聚合物常常适于用缨状微束理论作为两相体系来处理，这些体系是由微晶包埋在非结晶的无定形聚合物中而构成的。
questions.ref: UNIT 7 Morphology of Solid Polymers · Notes 4
questions.evidence: Polymers with medium to low crystallinity can often be advantageously treated by the fringed micelle concept as two-phase systems composed of crystallites imbedded in uncrystallized, amorphous polymer.
